text:
Maya: quick update from the microtest on simplified tier names + inline FAQ. saw a 22% lift on 'Start trial' CTR for developer personas and ~11% fewer billing questions to support. going to push the copy + inline FAQ variant tomorrow AM. any objections?

Leo: nice lift. can you paste the new one-line tier blurbs so i can slot them into the webinar deck?

Maya: sure —
Maya: "Starter — 1M tokens/month • great for prototypes & PoCs"
Maya: "Scale — reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput"
Maya: "Enterprise — private deployments, compliance & SLA options"

Ari: these read clean. recommend adding a one-sentence FAQ under each tier answering the highest-friction question. e.g., under Starter: "Can I upgrade mid-cycle? Yes — upgrades prorated immediately." cuts future ticket volume.

Sam: i'll take the FAQ updates and open the PR. aiming EOD.

Jordan: inbound-routing Q — are pricing-calc leads still flowing to SDR by default? can we route high-intent calc completions (committed_amount >= $12k) straight to AE?

Maya: plan is to tag and route by (intent_score, committed_amount, region). routing rule for test: AE if committed_amount >= 12000 OR intent_score >= 0.9, otherwise SDR nurture.

Ari: tiny pseudocode snippet i used for the test routing logic: 

```
if committed_amount >= 12000 or intent_score >= 0.9:
  lead.tag = "ae_queue"
else:
  lead.tag = "sdr_nurture"
lead.add_metadata("source", "pricing_calc_v3")
```

Sam: perfect, i'll mirror that in HubSpot. @ops-bot can you confirm the HubSpot token scopes?

ops-bot: HubSpot token check: scopes OK - crm.objects.contacts.write, workflows.write. Last rotated: 2025-02-03.

Leo: webinar idea: 20-minute session titled "Picking the right inference tier for your app" — use the new shortlines + 3 cost/perf scenarios to make it actionable. target date in two weeks. i'll draft slides.

Jordan: need product to provide 3 sizing examples (low-latency chat, batch-embedding, high-throughput inference) so we can show perf vs cost. i'll sync with product today.

Maya: also proposing an A/B on FAQ placement: variant A = inline FAQ under each tier (default), variant B = a consolidated FAQ accordion further down the page. small split on page traffic. will measure support ticket delta + CTR.

Sam: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing-site/pull/468 — includes both copy variants and the A/B flag. pushing preview now.

Ari: preview looks good. nit: under Scale change "reserved GPU pools" to "reserved GPU pools (dedicated capacity)" for clarity.

Maya: updated. final action items: @leo — slides draft, @jordan — confirm AE thresholds with revenue ops, @sam — finalize PR and HubSpot workflow, @ari — final copy QA. i'll run the A/B starting tomorrow and report metrics next week. :rocket:

Leo: will have first-pass deck by Tue.

Jordan: syncing with revops this afternoon.

Sam: deploying to staging now.

ops-bot: deploy to staging succeeded: sha=bd7a4c, preview_url=https://staging.redwood.ai/pricing?variant=inline-faq

Maya: awesome, thanks team :thumbsup:
